findings.claim: Human SLC29A1 contains a mitochondrial targeting motif at residues 1-24 that is absent in mouse.
findings.evidence_quote: The absence of the mitochondrial targeting motif in mouse suggests differences in subcellular localization, potentially altering mitochondrial transport functions present in humans.

findings.claim: SLC29A1 shares 78.4% global identity between human and mouse.
findings.evidence_quote: Sequence divergence reflected by 78.4% global identity may lead to altered structural or functional properties between the species orthologs.
